portfolio: INFRASTRUCTURE, TRANSPORT, REGIONAL DEVELOPMENT, COMMUNICATIONS, SPORT AND THE ARTS PORTFOLIO
text: Thank you.

portfolio: INFRASTRUCTURE, TRANSPORT, REGIONAL DEVELOPMENT, COMMUNICATIONS, SPORT AND THE ARTS PORTFOLIO
text: Thank you very much. Thank you all for your evidence here today and for the work I know that goes into preparing for estimates and appearing here. You go with the committee's thanks.

portfolio: INFRASTRUCTURE, TRANSPORT, REGIONAL DEVELOPMENT, COMMUNICATIONS, SPORT AND THE ARTS PORTFOLIO
text: Before I welcome representatives from the Special Broadcasting Service, I can say that I am now in a position to release officials from the National Gallery of Australia and the National Archives of Australia. I thank my colleagues for their cooperation in that respect.

portfolio: INFRASTRUCTURE, TRANSPORT, REGIONAL DEVELOPMENT, COMMUNICATIONS, SPORT AND THE ARTS PORTFOLIO
text: Thank you, Chair.

portfolio: INFRASTRUCTURE, TRANSPORT, REGIONAL DEVELOPMENT, COMMUNICATIONS, SPORT AND THE ARTS PORTFOLIO
text: I now call officers from the Special Broadcasting Service. I welcome Ms Palfreyman, managing director, and her colleagues to the table. Do you wish to make an opening statement?

portfolio: INFRASTRUCTURE, TRANSPORT, REGIONAL DEVELOPMENT, COMMUNICATIONS, SPORT AND THE ARTS PORTFOLIO
text:
Thank you, Chair, I do. Chair and committee members, thanks for the opportunity to make a brief statement. In an increasingly complex world, SBS plays a unique role in fostering understanding and connection across Australia through trusted journalism, multilingual services, First Nations media, distinctive Australian storytelling and shared national experiences. SBS's coverage of the FIFA World Cup 2026 is a key example of how we bring the nation together. More than 18 million Australians tuned in, making it the largest event in SBS's history. In homes, parks and pubs across the country, Australians from different cultures, languages and generations came together to watch the beautiful game and cheer on their teams, all provided free through SBS.

Beyond the World Cup, SBS was again ranked equal first as Australia's most trusted news organisation, delivering local news and information in more than 60 languages and showcasing diverse Australian stories through a content slate that reaches more than 13 million Australians.

SBS is more than a media company. It's a significant public policy asset. Using engaging content and services to support positive outcomes for communities across Australia through programs and initiatives such as Australia Explained, SBS Learn English, SBS Examines, Insight, The Point and the The Feed Influencer Debate series, SBS brings diverse perspectives into the national conversation. It encourages respectful exchange and strengthens communities' connection, belonging and participation. These outcomes sit at the heart of SBS's purpose and require deliberate action.

For example, earlier this month, SBS launched How Australia Works in English and multiple languages, providing practical information to people in helping them to understand Australia's democracy, institution and civic processes. It builds on SBS's more than 50-year role in supporting social cohesion and helping people participate fully in Australian society.

Looking ahead, as our population evolves and changes, the way people access information continues to change. SBS must evolve as well. One of our key priorities is the language services review, undertaken every five years following the census. The review helps ensure our language services continue to reflect contemporary Australia and meet the needs of the communities we serve. Public consultation on the draft language selection criteria is currently underway, with community feedback and census data informing SBS's future language offering from the end of 2027.

In a time of growing fragmentation and division, our role has never been more important. While the way we deliver our services continues to change, our responsibility remains constant—to inform, educate and entertain Australians and to reflect the full diversity of our nation in ways that strengthen connection, belonging and shared understanding. Thank you. I welcome your questions.

portfolio: INFRASTRUCTURE, TRANSPORT, REGIONAL DEVELOPMENT, COMMUNICATIONS, SPORT AND THE ARTS PORTFOLIO
text: Thank you very much.

portfolio: INFRASTRUCTURE, TRANSPORT, REGIONAL DEVELOPMENT, COMMUNICATIONS, SPORT AND THE ARTS PORTFOLIO
text: Thank you very much, Ms Palfreyman, to you and your team for your attendance. Apologies that we are running over. I want to start with your travel costs to the World Cup. Can you provide us with the details of those costs? Who attended? How many staff? Could you give us a breakdown of those costs?

portfolio: INFRASTRUCTURE, TRANSPORT, REGIONAL DEVELOPMENT, COMMUNICATIONS, SPORT AND THE ARTS PORTFOLIO
text: We did undertake a client event trip to the World Cup, as I think we mentioned when we last spoke in this forum. This event obviously enables us to generate revenue and is a significant portion of SBS's total commercial revenues. A client event of this nature actually forms part of the overall sponsorship arrangements with the key sponsors, who sponsor the World Cup on the SBS. The details of those arrangements are commercial-in-confidence. In saying that, I can answer some of your questions. We took 15 clients along—they are our key sponsors—to the event in America.

portfolio: INFRASTRUCTURE, TRANSPORT, REGIONAL DEVELOPMENT, COMMUNICATIONS, SPORT AND THE ARTS PORTFOLIO
text: Ms Palfreyman, this is Senate estimates, so SBS is accountable to the parliament for its expenditure. The fact that it might be confidential does not mean it is exempt from disclosure. If it is commercial-in-confidence, there may well be elements of this that could be redacted. I am seeking details as to these costs irrespective of whether you've taken clients or others. Could you please detail the costs of your travel to the FIFA World Cup?

portfolio: INFRASTRUCTURE, TRANSPORT, REGIONAL DEVELOPMENT, COMMUNICATIONS, SPORT AND THE ARTS PORTFOLIO
text: The event that you are referring to is a key part of our efforts to generate revenue for the FIFA World Cup. To share costs in this forum would put us at a commercial disadvantage. We are fighting for every ad dollar across the market. It is ever more competitive. We are not only competing with major broadcasters but, in fact, social media platforms and global SVOD players. One of my roles is to safeguard our ability to be efficient. Sharing information in this way in this forum would be akin to sharing our commercial strategy and what we do with our competitors, which works against our ability.

portfolio: INFRASTRUCTURE, TRANSPORT, REGIONAL DEVELOPMENT, COMMUNICATIONS, SPORT AND THE ARTS PORTFOLIO
text: Ms Palfreyman, I'm asking about your travel costs. I don't think this cuts the mustard. How many SBS staff travelled overseas for the FIFA World Cup?

portfolio: INFRASTRUCTURE, TRANSPORT, REGIONAL DEVELOPMENT, COMMUNICATIONS, SPORT AND THE ARTS PORTFOLIO
text: On the client event we're referring to, we had three SBS staff alongside 15 clients.

portfolio: INFRASTRUCTURE, TRANSPORT, REGIONAL DEVELOPMENT, COMMUNICATIONS, SPORT AND THE ARTS PORTFOLIO
text: Three. That was you?

portfolio: INFRASTRUCTURE, TRANSPORT, REGIONAL DEVELOPMENT, COMMUNICATIONS, SPORT AND THE ARTS PORTFOLIO
text: Yes.

portfolio: INFRASTRUCTURE, TRANSPORT, REGIONAL DEVELOPMENT, COMMUNICATIONS, SPORT AND THE ARTS PORTFOLIO
text: And who else attended from SBS?

portfolio: INFRASTRUCTURE, TRANSPORT, REGIONAL DEVELOPMENT, COMMUNICATIONS, SPORT AND THE ARTS PORTFOLIO
text: It was our commercial director—our director of media sales—me and our deputy chair at the time.

portfolio: INFRASTRUCTURE, TRANSPORT, REGIONAL DEVELOPMENT, COMMUNICATIONS, SPORT AND THE ARTS PORTFOLIO
text: The deputy chair?

portfolio: INFRASTRUCTURE, TRANSPORT, REGIONAL DEVELOPMENT, COMMUNICATIONS, SPORT AND THE ARTS PORTFOLIO
text: Yes.

portfolio: INFRASTRUCTURE, TRANSPORT, REGIONAL DEVELOPMENT, COMMUNICATIONS, SPORT AND THE ARTS PORTFOLIO
text: What were the costs for the SBS staff?

portfolio: INFRASTRUCTURE, TRANSPORT, REGIONAL DEVELOPMENT, COMMUNICATIONS, SPORT AND THE ARTS PORTFOLIO
text: Senator, all the costs are borne equally across the attendees. Obviously our government appropriation assumes that we earn commercial revenue. We compete in that landscape. It is the most competitive I've certainly seen it in my time. To share costs is akin to sharing our strategy. It is part of our commercial arrangements for those sponsorships across the event. It would significantly put us at a commercial disadvantage.

portfolio: INFRASTRUCTURE, TRANSPORT, REGIONAL DEVELOPMENT, COMMUNICATIONS, SPORT AND THE ARTS PORTFOLIO
text: Ms Palfreyman, this is Senate estimates. This is SBS, which is a public broadcaster, funded in large part by the taxpayer. What were your flight and accommodation costs along with the two other SBS executives?

portfolio: INFRASTRUCTURE, TRANSPORT, REGIONAL DEVELOPMENT, COMMUNICATIONS, SPORT AND THE ARTS PORTFOLIO
text: Senator, I understand that we are government funded, but we are hybrid government and commercial funded.

portfolio: INFRASTRUCTURE, TRANSPORT, REGIONAL DEVELOPMENT, COMMUNICATIONS, SPORT AND THE ARTS PORTFOLIO
text: It doesn't make you any less accountable, Ms Palfreyman. You need to answer these questions.

portfolio: INFRASTRUCTURE, TRANSPORT, REGIONAL DEVELOPMENT, COMMUNICATIONS, SPORT AND THE ARTS PORTFOLIO
text: I'm not suggesting we're not accountable; I'm suggesting that, to compete fairly in the commercial landscape, we need to safeguard our ability to be efficient. We are competing with other broadcasters in the ad market, and, if I were to share the numbers of our commercial arrangements with our sponsors, who sponsor our event—

portfolio: INFRASTRUCTURE, TRANSPORT, REGIONAL DEVELOPMENT, COMMUNICATIONS, SPORT AND THE ARTS PORTFOLIO
text: Ms Palfreyman, I'm asking about your flight costs and your accommodation costs. At this point in time, I am only asking about the costs of SBS personnel. It's a fundamental obligation when you appear before Senate estimates to share this information.

portfolio: INFRASTRUCTURE, TRANSPORT, REGIONAL DEVELOPMENT, COMMUNICATIONS, SPORT AND THE ARTS PORTFOLIO
text: I understand what you're asking.

portfolio: INFRASTRUCTURE, TRANSPORT, REGIONAL DEVELOPMENT, COMMUNICATIONS, SPORT AND THE ARTS PORTFOLIO
text: You are required to answer these questions. They are basic questions that go to your financial expenditure.

portfolio: INFRASTRUCTURE, TRANSPORT, REGIONAL DEVELOPMENT, COMMUNICATIONS, SPORT AND THE ARTS PORTFOLIO
text: Senator, they go to our revenue generating activity, as I've outlined. The client event that we're talking about is part of our commercial arrangements for the sponsorship of the World Cup by our key sponsors. To disclose how we do our revenue generating activities would be challenging.

portfolio: INFRASTRUCTURE, TRANSPORT, REGIONAL DEVELOPMENT, COMMUNICATIONS, SPORT AND THE ARTS PORTFOLIO
text: Ms Palfreyman, I'm asking for yours and the other two executives' total costs—flights, accommodation and incidentals, please. How many days were you there? Did you fly business class? I assume you did. Could you please detail those costs?

portfolio: INFRASTRUCTURE, TRANSPORT, REGIONAL DEVELOPMENT, COMMUNICATIONS, SPORT AND THE ARTS PORTFOLIO
text: I'm happy to take that away and come back to you with what I can provide. I can tell you that we were there for eight days and attended three events. I can tell you that those events were general admission. Of course, they were FIFA World Cup events. I'm happy to take away and answer your other questions.

portfolio: INFRASTRUCTURE, TRANSPORT, REGIONAL DEVELOPMENT, COMMUNICATIONS, SPORT AND THE ARTS PORTFOLIO
text: I have previously asked you about these costs. I don't think it's acceptable that you have come to Senate estimates today not prepared to answer these questions. You were already on notice that I was seeking this information.

portfolio: INFRASTRUCTURE, TRANSPORT, REGIONAL DEVELOPMENT, COMMUNICATIONS, SPORT AND THE ARTS PORTFOLIO
text: I understand that. I'm saying that for us to disclose our commercial activities puts us at a disadvantage in a market that is so competitive. I'm happy to take that away and look at what we can provide for you. It is part of our sponsorship activities. It is underwritten by the sponsorship activity from our clients. That money allows us to invest in activities like the FIFA World Cup.

portfolio: INFRASTRUCTURE, TRANSPORT, REGIONAL DEVELOPMENT, COMMUNICATIONS, SPORT AND THE ARTS PORTFOLIO
text: Where you put your line items as to your own travel costs is a matter for you. You can say that you can offset it in any number of ways. Equally, there is an argument that this is offset through taxpayer funds. It doesn't really matter because what matters is that you are accountable to the parliament and to this committee for your expenditure and operations. Are you able to ask someone in your team to call those numbers up?

portfolio: INFRASTRUCTURE, TRANSPORT, REGIONAL DEVELOPMENT, COMMUNICATIONS, SPORT AND THE ARTS PORTFOLIO
text: Senator, I will take that away and come back to you on notice. Of course we are accountable. We are aware of that accountability. We have tabled our annual report. We acquit our disclosure obligations. However, we are one-third commercially funded. The ad landscape is acutely competitive. Our ability to compete requires us to be cautious with our commercial strategy and revenue generating activities.

portfolio: INFRASTRUCTURE, TRANSPORT, REGIONAL DEVELOPMENT, COMMUNICATIONS, SPORT AND THE ARTS PORTFOLIO
text: I think you are digging yourself a hole. There is no justification for you to not answer this question. I'm not even asking about the sponsorship arrangements. Who were the sponsors, by the way, of the World Cup?

portfolio: INFRASTRUCTURE, TRANSPORT, REGIONAL DEVELOPMENT, COMMUNICATIONS, SPORT AND THE ARTS PORTFOLIO
text: Senator, off the top of my head, we had Kia, Hisense, Hungry Jack's, McDonald's, bet365 and the Commonwealth Bank.

portfolio: INFRASTRUCTURE, TRANSPORT, REGIONAL DEVELOPMENT, COMMUNICATIONS, SPORT AND THE ARTS PORTFOLIO
text: How do your travel costs relate to your broader commercial strategy? How does keeping those secret—

portfolio: INFRASTRUCTURE, TRANSPORT, REGIONAL DEVELOPMENT, COMMUNICATIONS, SPORT AND THE ARTS PORTFOLIO
text: As a rights broadcaster for the FIFA World Cup, it is an expectation in market that we can compete alongside other broadcasters. It is commonplace for clients who help, through their sponsorship activities, fund the event and allow us to put it on for all Australians free on SBS. The expectation is part of understanding the event. Attending the event is a well-trod path for all broadcasters. I can assure you that we spend less than other broadcasters with their overseas events.

portfolio: INFRASTRUCTURE, TRANSPORT, REGIONAL DEVELOPMENT, COMMUNICATIONS, SPORT AND THE ARTS PORTFOLIO
text: How much is less than other broadcasters? Are we talking $100,000? Are we talking $80,000? Are we talking $200,000? Could you give me a ballpark figure?

portfolio: INFRASTRUCTURE, TRANSPORT, REGIONAL DEVELOPMENT, COMMUNICATIONS, SPORT AND THE ARTS PORTFOLIO
text: We take 15 clients to an event. We have flights. We have—

portfolio: INFRASTRUCTURE, TRANSPORT, REGIONAL DEVELOPMENT, COMMUNICATIONS, SPORT AND THE ARTS PORTFOLIO
text: No. I'm asking about your flights, accommodation and SBS costs only. Are we talking $20,000? Do you fly business class?

portfolio: INFRASTRUCTURE, TRANSPORT, REGIONAL DEVELOPMENT, COMMUNICATIONS, SPORT AND THE ARTS PORTFOLIO
text: We did fly business class.

portfolio: INFRASTRUCTURE, TRANSPORT, REGIONAL DEVELOPMENT, COMMUNICATIONS, SPORT AND THE ARTS PORTFOLIO
text: I'm not taking issue with you going to the United States for this event at all. You have taken only a small team. Personally, I don't think that's unreasonable whatsoever. I think it's most unreasonable not to answer these questions.

portfolio: INFRASTRUCTURE, TRANSPORT, REGIONAL DEVELOPMENT, COMMUNICATIONS, SPORT AND THE ARTS PORTFOLIO
text: Well, I appreciate that is your position. We are competing—

portfolio: INFRASTRUCTURE, TRANSPORT, REGIONAL DEVELOPMENT, COMMUNICATIONS, SPORT AND THE ARTS PORTFOLIO
text: They are the rules of the Senate.

portfolio: INFRASTRUCTURE, TRANSPORT, REGIONAL DEVELOPMENT, COMMUNICATIONS, SPORT AND THE ARTS PORTFOLIO
text: I understand that. I am saying that to share commercial information that is part of our sponsorship arrangements would disadvantage our ability to be competitive.

portfolio: INFRASTRUCTURE, TRANSPORT, REGIONAL DEVELOPMENT, COMMUNICATIONS, SPORT AND THE ARTS PORTFOLIO
text: I am very concerned about the position you have taken. I am going to seek some further advice about this and then consider my options. I ask you to go away and seek some advice on this. I don't think this is appropriate. What was the total cost to SBS of hosting the FIFA World Cup?

portfolio: INFRASTRUCTURE, TRANSPORT, REGIONAL DEVELOPMENT, COMMUNICATIONS, SPORT AND THE ARTS PORTFOLIO
text: Sorry, Senator? The question is in terms of broadcasting the FIFA World Cup?

portfolio: INFRASTRUCTURE, TRANSPORT, REGIONAL DEVELOPMENT, COMMUNICATIONS, SPORT AND THE ARTS PORTFOLIO
text: Yes. What were the broadcasting costs and other costs?

portfolio: INFRASTRUCTURE, TRANSPORT, REGIONAL DEVELOPMENT, COMMUNICATIONS, SPORT AND THE ARTS PORTFOLIO
text: It's a similar answer, Senator. To disclose that would infer what the rights cost for an event of that nature. As you can appreciate, sports rights are really competitive. It is an anchor in many schedules of other broadcasters as well as tech platforms and SVOD players, who are now competing for broadcast rights, so to share the cost of hosting and airing the FIFA World Cup would put us at a commercial disadvantage.

portfolio: INFRASTRUCTURE, TRANSPORT, REGIONAL DEVELOPMENT, COMMUNICATIONS, SPORT AND THE ARTS PORTFOLIO
text: The secretary has very helpfully given me the rules for estimates. The only way, Ms Palfreyman, that you can decline to answer that question is to take a public interest immunity claim. Is that what you are intending to do?

portfolio: INFRASTRUCTURE, TRANSPORT, REGIONAL DEVELOPMENT, COMMUNICATIONS, SPORT AND THE ARTS PORTFOLIO
text: No, Senator. As I said, I will take it on notice and come back to you and see what I can provide.

portfolio: INFRASTRUCTURE, TRANSPORT, REGIONAL DEVELOPMENT, COMMUNICATIONS, SPORT AND THE ARTS PORTFOLIO
text: As I said, this is the second time you have taken this on notice.

portfolio: INFRASTRUCTURE, TRANSPORT, REGIONAL DEVELOPMENT, COMMUNICATIONS, SPORT AND THE ARTS PORTFOLIO
text: Senator—

portfolio: INFRASTRUCTURE, TRANSPORT, REGIONAL DEVELOPMENT, COMMUNICATIONS, SPORT AND THE ARTS PORTFOLIO
text: I would ask that you come back to us promptly within the next day or so as soon as you possibly can. You have been on notice for many months about this. I look forward to getting those fulsome responses as soon as possible.

portfolio: INFRASTRUCTURE, TRANSPORT, REGIONAL DEVELOPMENT, COMMUNICATIONS, SPORT AND THE ARTS PORTFOLIO
text: I'm happy to take that on notice, Senator.

portfolio: INFRASTRUCTURE, TRANSPORT, REGIONAL DEVELOPMENT, COMMUNICATIONS, SPORT AND THE ARTS PORTFOLIO
text: Can you tell me about other overseas travel? I believe SBS staff went to MIPCOM Cannes just recently. Is that right?

portfolio: INFRASTRUCTURE, TRANSPORT, REGIONAL DEVELOPMENT, COMMUNICATIONS, SPORT AND THE ARTS PORTFOLIO
text: There was an LA Screenings event. Is that what you are referring to? That sounds correct. That's one of the key content buying trips, yes.

portfolio: INFRASTRUCTURE, TRANSPORT, REGIONAL DEVELOPMENT, COMMUNICATIONS, SPORT AND THE ARTS PORTFOLIO
text: How many from SBS attended MIPCOM?

portfolio: INFRASTRUCTURE, TRANSPORT, REGIONAL DEVELOPMENT, COMMUNICATIONS, SPORT AND THE ARTS PORTFOLIO
text: Let me just find that for you. I don't have that in front of me. We may be able to get it while we're talking.

portfolio: INFRASTRUCTURE, TRANSPORT, REGIONAL DEVELOPMENT, COMMUNICATIONS, SPORT AND THE ARTS PORTFOLIO
text: Did you go on that trip?

portfolio: INFRASTRUCTURE, TRANSPORT, REGIONAL DEVELOPMENT, COMMUNICATIONS, SPORT AND THE ARTS PORTFOLIO
text: No. I didn't, Senator.

portfolio: INFRASTRUCTURE, TRANSPORT, REGIONAL DEVELOPMENT, COMMUNICATIONS, SPORT AND THE ARTS PORTFOLIO
text: Is that a program buying trip?

portfolio: INFRASTRUCTURE, TRANSPORT, REGIONAL DEVELOPMENT, COMMUNICATIONS, SPORT AND THE ARTS PORTFOLIO
text: Yes. MIPCOM is a global trip where program makers and broadcasters meet to discuss upcoming content and arrangements to purchase content.

portfolio: INFRASTRUCTURE, TRANSPORT, REGIONAL DEVELOPMENT, COMMUNICATIONS, SPORT AND THE ARTS PORTFOLIO
text: So you don't know how many went from SBS?

portfolio: INFRASTRUCTURE, TRANSPORT, REGIONAL DEVELOPMENT, COMMUNICATIONS, SPORT AND THE ARTS PORTFOLIO
text: I don't have that right in front of me, but we will seek to get it.

portfolio: INFRASTRUCTURE, TRANSPORT, REGIONAL DEVELOPMENT, COMMUNICATIONS, SPORT AND THE ARTS PORTFOLIO
text: What were the travel costs for that trip?

portfolio: INFRASTRUCTURE, TRANSPORT, REGIONAL DEVELOPMENT, COMMUNICATIONS, SPORT AND THE ARTS PORTFOLIO
text: We don't have that in front of us right now, Senator, but we can come back to that within the meeting. We may be able to share that with you.

portfolio: INFRASTRUCTURE, TRANSPORT, REGIONAL DEVELOPMENT, COMMUNICATIONS, SPORT AND THE ARTS PORTFOLIO
text: If you could, I'm looking for flights, accommodation and other costs. What was the itinerary for that trip?

portfolio: INFRASTRUCTURE, TRANSPORT, REGIONAL DEVELOPMENT, COMMUNICATIONS, SPORT AND THE ARTS PORTFOLIO
text: Again, I don't have the specific itinerary in front of me. I imagine there's lots of screening of content for broadcasters and those wishing to purchase content. There's lots of meetings with production companies around the world to look at scripts and upcoming plans to see if it's in line with our charter. If it's something we may wish to purchase, there are meetings often with companies we might be looking to do some coproductions on. It's a mix of all those types of events and meetings.

portfolio: INFRASTRUCTURE, TRANSPORT, REGIONAL DEVELOPMENT, COMMUNICATIONS, SPORT AND THE ARTS PORTFOLIO
text: I'm keen to get that information back from you. Did staff conduct any personal travel? Did anyone bolt on any holidays before or after that trip?

portfolio: INFRASTRUCTURE, TRANSPORT, REGIONAL DEVELOPMENT, COMMUNICATIONS, SPORT AND THE ARTS PORTFOLIO
text: After the MIPCOM event?

portfolio: INFRASTRUCTURE, TRANSPORT, REGIONAL DEVELOPMENT, COMMUNICATIONS, SPORT AND THE ARTS PORTFOLIO
text: That's right.

portfolio: INFRASTRUCTURE, TRANSPORT, REGIONAL DEVELOPMENT, COMMUNICATIONS, SPORT AND THE ARTS PORTFOLIO
text: Not to my knowledge. Again, as we seek to get that information for you, we can clarify that question.

portfolio: INFRASTRUCTURE, TRANSPORT, REGIONAL DEVELOPMENT, COMMUNICATIONS, SPORT AND THE ARTS PORTFOLIO
text: If you could. What are the sorts of cost controls you impose when traveling overseas?

portfolio: INFRASTRUCTURE, TRANSPORT, REGIONAL DEVELOPMENT, COMMUNICATIONS, SPORT AND THE ARTS PORTFOLIO
text: There is a process for approvals that goes up through relevant directors and through to the CFO. We have travel policies in line that help us and help the business navigate travel, be it domestic flights or overseas flights, and what the allowances are.

portfolio: INFRASTRUCTURE, TRANSPORT, REGIONAL DEVELOPMENT, COMMUNICATIONS, SPORT AND THE ARTS PORTFOLIO
text: Could you provide further detail on notice? Could you also provide details of meals and alcohol consumption as well?

portfolio: INFRASTRUCTURE, TRANSPORT, REGIONAL DEVELOPMENT, COMMUNICATIONS, SPORT AND THE ARTS PORTFOLIO
text: Yes. We can take that on notice and come back to you, Senator.

portfolio: INFRASTRUCTURE, TRANSPORT, REGIONAL DEVELOPMENT, COMMUNICATIONS, SPORT AND THE ARTS PORTFOLIO
text: What other international travel have staff undertaken this year?

portfolio: INFRASTRUCTURE, TRANSPORT, REGIONAL DEVELOPMENT, COMMUNICATIONS, SPORT AND THE ARTS PORTFOLIO
text: It mostly relates to content screening events. You highlighted MIPCOM being one of them. At times we film content overseas as well. Obviously, with the FIFA World Cup, we had a small team over there facilitating our broadcast.

portfolio: INFRASTRUCTURE, TRANSPORT, REGIONAL DEVELOPMENT, COMMUNICATIONS, SPORT AND THE ARTS PORTFOLIO
text: So it wasn't just the three—you and two others? There was also a broadcast team?

portfolio: INFRASTRUCTURE, TRANSPORT, REGIONAL DEVELOPMENT, COMMUNICATIONS, SPORT AND THE ARTS PORTFOLIO
text: There was a small broadcast team, noting that our main studio was here in Sydney where, as ever, our intent is to be as efficient as possible. We had our main studio here in Sydney. We did have some production crew over in America to reflect the event, yes.

portfolio: INFRASTRUCTURE, TRANSPORT, REGIONAL DEVELOPMENT, COMMUNICATIONS, SPORT AND THE ARTS PORTFOLIO
text: Could you also please provide those costs as well?

portfolio: INFRASTRUCTURE, TRANSPORT, REGIONAL DEVELOPMENT, COMMUNICATIONS, SPORT AND THE ARTS PORTFOLIO
text: Yes. We can take that on notice.

portfolio: INFRASTRUCTURE, TRANSPORT, REGIONAL DEVELOPMENT, COMMUNICATIONS, SPORT AND THE ARTS PORTFOLIO
text: Of the broadcast team.

portfolio: INFRASTRUCTURE, TRANSPORT, REGIONAL DEVELOPMENT, COMMUNICATIONS, SPORT AND THE ARTS PORTFOLIO
text: In the last set of QONs, we responded to another content buying trip, which was LA Screenings.

portfolio: INFRASTRUCTURE, TRANSPORT, REGIONAL DEVELOPMENT, COMMUNICATIONS, SPORT AND THE ARTS PORTFOLIO
text: Yes.

portfolio: INFRASTRUCTURE, TRANSPORT, REGIONAL DEVELOPMENT, COMMUNICATIONS, SPORT AND THE ARTS PORTFOLIO
text: That was included in the previous QON response. That was this calendar year, yes.

portfolio: INFRASTRUCTURE, TRANSPORT, REGIONAL DEVELOPMENT, COMMUNICATIONS, SPORT AND THE ARTS PORTFOLIO
text: We've got the details of that. The travel cost over the 11-day period was $15,510 for flights; just over $10,000 for accommodation; and $1,489 for incidentals, including taxi and meals. I'm trying to work out how many people attended Los Angeles.

portfolio: INFRASTRUCTURE, TRANSPORT, REGIONAL DEVELOPMENT, COMMUNICATIONS, SPORT AND THE ARTS PORTFOLIO
text: I believe we had two in attendance in LA.

portfolio: INFRASTRUCTURE, TRANSPORT, REGIONAL DEVELOPMENT, COMMUNICATIONS, SPORT AND THE ARTS PORTFOLIO
text: And two staff went to an LA Dodgers game?

portfolio: INFRASTRUCTURE, TRANSPORT, REGIONAL DEVELOPMENT, COMMUNICATIONS, SPORT AND THE ARTS PORTFOLIO
text: Yes, those tickets were provided to them by the host distributor.

portfolio: INFRASTRUCTURE, TRANSPORT, REGIONAL DEVELOPMENT, COMMUNICATIONS, SPORT AND THE ARTS PORTFOLIO
text: Were there any other?

portfolio: INFRASTRUCTURE, TRANSPORT, REGIONAL DEVELOPMENT, COMMUNICATIONS, SPORT AND THE ARTS PORTFOLIO
text: Not to my knowledge, no.

portfolio: INFRASTRUCTURE, TRANSPORT, REGIONAL DEVELOPMENT, COMMUNICATIONS, SPORT AND THE ARTS PORTFOLIO
text: Any other events?

portfolio: INFRASTRUCTURE, TRANSPORT, REGIONAL DEVELOPMENT, COMMUNICATIONS, SPORT AND THE ARTS PORTFOLIO
text: Outside the content screening event?

portfolio: INFRASTRUCTURE, TRANSPORT, REGIONAL DEVELOPMENT, COMMUNICATIONS, SPORT AND THE ARTS PORTFOLIO
text: Yes.

portfolio: INFRASTRUCTURE, TRANSPORT, REGIONAL DEVELOPMENT, COMMUNICATIONS, SPORT AND THE ARTS PORTFOLIO
text: Not to my knowledge, no.

portfolio: INFRASTRUCTURE, TRANSPORT, REGIONAL DEVELOPMENT, COMMUNICATIONS, SPORT AND THE ARTS PORTFOLIO
text: Have you had Upfront, your showcase for next year?

portfolio: INFRASTRUCTURE, TRANSPORT, REGIONAL DEVELOPMENT, COMMUNICATIONS, SPORT AND THE ARTS PORTFOLIO
text: Yes, we hosted our Upfront in September this year. We shared our 2027 content slate with our client partners, our agency partners in Sydney and in the other markets. The purpose of Upfront is obviously to kick off the commercial negotiations for advertising revenue in 2027.

portfolio: INFRASTRUCTURE, TRANSPORT, REGIONAL DEVELOPMENT, COMMUNICATIONS, SPORT AND THE ARTS PORTFOLIO
text: What was the cost of that event? What date was that event? Where was it held? I have previously raised concern about the very significant costs.

portfolio: INFRASTRUCTURE, TRANSPORT, REGIONAL DEVELOPMENT, COMMUNICATIONS, SPORT AND THE ARTS PORTFOLIO
text: The date of the event—

portfolio: INFRASTRUCTURE, TRANSPORT, REGIONAL DEVELOPMENT, COMMUNICATIONS, SPORT AND THE ARTS PORTFOLIO
text: The context is that I have previously raised concern about the significant cost of this event in previous years. I think the previous year was quite substantial; it was well over $1 million, from my recollection.

portfolio: INFRASTRUCTURE, TRANSPORT, REGIONAL DEVELOPMENT, COMMUNICATIONS, SPORT AND THE ARTS PORTFOLIO
text: No, I believe it was about half that number in previous years. It wasn't over $1 million, no.

portfolio: INFRASTRUCTURE, TRANSPORT, REGIONAL DEVELOPMENT, COMMUNICATIONS, SPORT AND THE ARTS PORTFOLIO
text: I stand corrected on that. I will double-check that. Do you have those costs? What was the cost of the showcase or the Upfronts for this year?

portfolio: INFRASTRUCTURE, TRANSPORT, REGIONAL DEVELOPMENT, COMMUNICATIONS, SPORT AND THE ARTS PORTFOLIO
text: You asked about the dates. The Sydney event was held on 1 September, with the other events held shortly thereafter. Obviously, as I mentioned before, our revenue generating activities are commercial in confidence. We endeavour to be as efficient as we can. I can assure you we are thoughtful in how we deploy our resources. It's a critical event on the calendar to kick off the commercial negotiations for 2027. You'll see in the annual report we've tabled today that we drive significant commercial revenue. That revenue affords us the opportunity to not only cover the commercial activities but invest in more Australian content. We're thoughtful in how we do it.

portfolio: INFRASTRUCTURE, TRANSPORT, REGIONAL DEVELOPMENT, COMMUNICATIONS, SPORT AND THE ARTS PORTFOLIO
text: That's terrific, Ms Palfreyman, but I was asking for the cost of that event.

portfolio: INFRASTRUCTURE, TRANSPORT, REGIONAL DEVELOPMENT, COMMUNICATIONS, SPORT AND THE ARTS PORTFOLIO
text: I appreciate that. As I've said, that cost is commercial in confidence. The climate has never been more competitive. Sharing that cost with you is akin to emailing the CEOs of our competitors about what we do and how we do it. It would put us at a disadvantage to deliver that efficiently.

portfolio: INFRASTRUCTURE, TRANSPORT, REGIONAL DEVELOPMENT, COMMUNICATIONS, SPORT AND THE ARTS PORTFOLIO
text: Ms Palfreyman, this is not a broadcasting deal. This is not a sponsorship deal. This is the SBS's costs for your Upfront event, which you have previously disclosed. There is absolutely no basis, like with your own travel costs and the travel costs for America, to decline to answer this question.

portfolio: INFRASTRUCTURE, TRANSPORT, REGIONAL DEVELOPMENT, COMMUNICATIONS, SPORT AND THE ARTS PORTFOLIO
text: It's a commercial event. It's core to our commercial strategy. It generates—

portfolio: INFRASTRUCTURE, TRANSPORT, REGIONAL DEVELOPMENT, COMMUNICATIONS, SPORT AND THE ARTS PORTFOLIO
text: You're a public broadcaster, Ms Palfreyman.

portfolio: INFRASTRUCTURE, TRANSPORT, REGIONAL DEVELOPMENT, COMMUNICATIONS, SPORT AND THE ARTS PORTFOLIO
text: I'm aware of that. It allows us to generate $150 million, as per our last annual report. Sharing this information puts us at a commercial disadvantage. It is sharing with our competitors our activity, what we do and how we do it. As ever, we focus on efficiency. My team estimates we spend one quarter of what our competitors do. We are a hybrid funded organisation and need to be able to compete and put our best foot forward as we launch our commercial strategy and market.

portfolio: INFRASTRUCTURE, TRANSPORT, REGIONAL DEVELOPMENT, COMMUNICATIONS, SPORT AND THE ARTS PORTFOLIO
text:
Ms Palfreyman, can I suggest that if you are not willing to comply with the rules of the Senate and your responsibilities as the managing director of SBS, a publicly funded broadcaster, then that is a serious issue. I will read from the rules of estimates:

The Senate has resolved that there are no areas in connection with the expenditure of public funds where any person has a discretion to withhold details or explanations unless expressly provided otherwise.

The only basis on which you can withhold this information is to take a public interest immunity claim. It is open to you to take it on notice for the purposes of a PII claim. Otherwise, you are required to answer these questions. You don't have this discretion, Ms Palfreyman.

portfolio: INFRASTRUCTURE, TRANSPORT, REGIONAL DEVELOPMENT, COMMUNICATIONS, SPORT AND THE ARTS PORTFOLIO
text: Senator, we are a hybrid funded organisation. Our government appropriation assumes our ability to earn commercial revenue. We need to compete with the landscape. To share that information—

portfolio: INFRASTRUCTURE, TRANSPORT, REGIONAL DEVELOPMENT, COMMUNICATIONS, SPORT AND THE ARTS PORTFOLIO
text: Ms Palfreyman, you are running SBS.

portfolio: INFRASTRUCTURE, TRANSPORT, REGIONAL DEVELOPMENT, COMMUNICATIONS, SPORT AND THE ARTS PORTFOLIO
text: I'm aware of that.

portfolio: INFRASTRUCTURE, TRANSPORT, REGIONAL DEVELOPMENT, COMMUNICATIONS, SPORT AND THE ARTS PORTFOLIO
text: You are subject to the rules of the Senate and the parliament.

portfolio: INFRASTRUCTURE, TRANSPORT, REGIONAL DEVELOPMENT, COMMUNICATIONS, SPORT AND THE ARTS PORTFOLIO
text: Senator—

portfolio: INFRASTRUCTURE, TRANSPORT, REGIONAL DEVELOPMENT, COMMUNICATIONS, SPORT AND THE ARTS PORTFOLIO
text: That doesn't give you a 'get out of jail' card.

portfolio: INFRASTRUCTURE, TRANSPORT, REGIONAL DEVELOPMENT, COMMUNICATIONS, SPORT AND THE ARTS PORTFOLIO
text: I will intervene now. This has gone back and forth a few times. I don't understand, though Ms Palfreyman can speak for herself, that she has given evidence that she is not going to abide by the rules of the parliament. As I understand it, these questions have been taken on notice and will be considered for the purposes of the basis on which information can be provided. If there is a need to make a claim or provide information, it will be done so, and we can evaluate either the claim or the information that has been provided on that occasion. I think we are clear that there is a requirement to answer questions at estimates. That is as I understand the position that has been expressed by Ms Palfreyman. Am I wrong?

portfolio: INFRASTRUCTURE, TRANSPORT, REGIONAL DEVELOPMENT, COMMUNICATIONS, SPORT AND THE ARTS PORTFOLIO
text: You are right, Chair. I am happy to take that on notice and see what information we can provide.

portfolio: INFRASTRUCTURE, TRANSPORT, REGIONAL DEVELOPMENT, COMMUNICATIONS, SPORT AND THE ARTS PORTFOLIO
text: Chair, you have just prompted Ms Palfreyman to take that on notice. I did raise that this was open to you. Up until that point, you indicated that you were declining to answer the question. You could take that on notice and take some advice, including whether you wish to make a public interest immunity claim. I am concerned. I think you are on very thin ice, Ms Palfreyman, because you have previously provided us with the costs of this very event in previous years. What has changed?

portfolio: INFRASTRUCTURE, TRANSPORT, REGIONAL DEVELOPMENT, COMMUNICATIONS, SPORT AND THE ARTS PORTFOLIO
text: Senator, I am aware of that disclosure. It was about this time last year, I think. The landscape is more competitive than we've ever had to deal with. The pressure—

portfolio: INFRASTRUCTURE, TRANSPORT, REGIONAL DEVELOPMENT, COMMUNICATIONS, SPORT AND THE ARTS PORTFOLIO
text: But the rules of the Senate haven't changed.

portfolio: INFRASTRUCTURE, TRANSPORT, REGIONAL DEVELOPMENT, COMMUNICATIONS, SPORT AND THE ARTS PORTFOLIO
text: I'm not suggesting they haven't. I'm suggesting that providing that information shares sensitive commercial information with our competitors. My role is to ensure that we can continue to be efficient. However, I am happy to take it on notice and see what information we can provide to you.

portfolio: INFRASTRUCTURE, TRANSPORT, REGIONAL DEVELOPMENT, COMMUNICATIONS, SPORT AND THE ARTS PORTFOLIO
text: Where did you hold this event?

portfolio: INFRASTRUCTURE, TRANSPORT, REGIONAL DEVELOPMENT, COMMUNICATIONS, SPORT AND THE ARTS PORTFOLIO
text: It was held in Town Hall in Sydney. Are you referring to the Sydney event?

portfolio: INFRASTRUCTURE, TRANSPORT, REGIONAL DEVELOPMENT, COMMUNICATIONS, SPORT AND THE ARTS PORTFOLIO
text: I don't know how many events there were. Could you run through the events?

portfolio: INFRASTRUCTURE, TRANSPORT, REGIONAL DEVELOPMENT, COMMUNICATIONS, SPORT AND THE ARTS PORTFOLIO
text: There was an event in Sydney. As we're a national broadcaster, there were events in other capital cities—Melbourne, Brisbane, Perth and Adelaide.

portfolio: INFRASTRUCTURE, TRANSPORT, REGIONAL DEVELOPMENT, COMMUNICATIONS, SPORT AND THE ARTS PORTFOLIO
text: Where were the events held in each of those cities?

portfolio: INFRASTRUCTURE, TRANSPORT, REGIONAL DEVELOPMENT, COMMUNICATIONS, SPORT AND THE ARTS PORTFOLIO
text: They were at restaurants or small function centres.

portfolio: INFRASTRUCTURE, TRANSPORT, REGIONAL DEVELOPMENT, COMMUNICATIONS, SPORT AND THE ARTS PORTFOLIO
text: Did they involve the serving of food and alcohol?

portfolio: INFRASTRUCTURE, TRANSPORT, REGIONAL DEVELOPMENT, COMMUNICATIONS, SPORT AND THE ARTS PORTFOLIO
text: It involves a one-hour presentation over lunch. The presentation includes our content slate for 2027 to help explain what plans we have in store for engaging Australians and how clients can partner with us.

portfolio: INFRASTRUCTURE, TRANSPORT, REGIONAL DEVELOPMENT, COMMUNICATIONS, SPORT AND THE ARTS PORTFOLIO
text: I'm not taking issue with the events that you are running because that is an important part of the work that you need to do to attract revenue. I totally understand that. I went to the ABC Showcase last week. They don't have the same burden that SBS has in terms of attracting revenue. What I am concerned about is this change in the way you are operating and the lack of disclosure about those costs. You have taken it on notice. The Sydney event was at the Sydney Town Hall. Is that right?

portfolio: INFRASTRUCTURE, TRANSPORT, REGIONAL DEVELOPMENT, COMMUNICATIONS, SPORT AND THE ARTS PORTFOLIO
text: That's right.

portfolio: INFRASTRUCTURE, TRANSPORT, REGIONAL DEVELOPMENT, COMMUNICATIONS, SPORT AND THE ARTS PORTFOLIO
text: Where were the other events held?

portfolio: INFRASTRUCTURE, TRANSPORT, REGIONAL DEVELOPMENT, COMMUNICATIONS, SPORT AND THE ARTS PORTFOLIO
text: We can provide this information on notice, if that's helpful. There was a restaurant in Melbourne called the Terrace. There was a place in Brisbane called the Warehouse. There was a place in Perth called Cleaver House. There was a similar restaurant in Adelaide.

portfolio: INFRASTRUCTURE, TRANSPORT, REGIONAL DEVELOPMENT, COMMUNICATIONS, SPORT AND THE ARTS PORTFOLIO
text: Okay. Thank you. I want to turn to evidence you gave in the last Senate estimates. We discussed the SBS directive to staff not to use the term 'Hamas run health ministry'. Ms Wicks defended the decision by saying that SBS audiences know what Hamas is because the SBS is clear in its coverage about Hamas being a terrorist organisation. If that is the case, why do the SBS's editorial guidelines instruct staff to describe Hamas as militants?

portfolio: INFRASTRUCTURE, TRANSPORT, REGIONAL DEVELOPMENT, COMMUNICATIONS, SPORT AND THE ARTS PORTFOLIO
text: Sorry, the question being?

portfolio: INFRASTRUCTURE, TRANSPORT, REGIONAL DEVELOPMENT, COMMUNICATIONS, SPORT AND THE ARTS PORTFOLIO
text: Why do the SBS editorial guidelines include an instruction to staff to describe Hamas as militants?

portfolio: INFRASTRUCTURE, TRANSPORT, REGIONAL DEVELOPMENT, COMMUNICATIONS, SPORT AND THE ARTS PORTFOLIO
text: I will pass over to Ms Wicks.

portfolio: INFRASTRUCTURE, TRANSPORT, REGIONAL DEVELOPMENT, COMMUNICATIONS, SPORT AND THE ARTS PORTFOLIO
text: We describe them as militants. We also provide the additional context that they are designated as a terrorist organisation by the Australian government and many others.

portfolio: INFRASTRUCTURE, TRANSPORT, REGIONAL DEVELOPMENT, COMMUNICATIONS, SPORT AND THE ARTS PORTFOLIO
text: But the instruction is that they are not to be described as terrorists. Are they to be described as militants?

portfolio: INFRASTRUCTURE, TRANSPORT, REGIONAL DEVELOPMENT, COMMUNICATIONS, SPORT AND THE ARTS PORTFOLIO
text: Correct. SBS doesn't refer to anyone as a terrorist, but we absolutely attribute that. We give that context to our audiences by explaining that they are designated a terrorist organisation.

portfolio: INFRASTRUCTURE, TRANSPORT, REGIONAL DEVELOPMENT, COMMUNICATIONS, SPORT AND THE ARTS PORTFOLIO
text: Where do you give that context? Where is that in your editorial guidelines?

portfolio: INFRASTRUCTURE, TRANSPORT, REGIONAL DEVELOPMENT, COMMUNICATIONS, SPORT AND THE ARTS PORTFOLIO
text: I'm not sure which guidelines you are referring to there. We have a style guide, and we have some editorial guidelines within that and within our copy. If there is a particular story that is of concern, we definitely do refer to Hamas being designated as a terrorist organisation frequently in our coverage. We feel that there has been enough context over time for audiences ultimately to understand what that organisation is and what they stand for.

portfolio: INFRASTRUCTURE, TRANSPORT, REGIONAL DEVELOPMENT, COMMUNICATIONS, SPORT AND THE ARTS PORTFOLIO
text: I'm just concerned. In relation to the evidence you gave last time, you made it clear that SBS audiences know what Hamas is because SBS makes that clear. Now we see in your guidelines that you are declining to refer to Hamas as a terrorist organisation, which is exactly what it is. I'm looking at the editorial guidance on antisemitism of November 2023. Are you familiar with that guidance?

portfolio: INFRASTRUCTURE, TRANSPORT, REGIONAL DEVELOPMENT, COMMUNICATIONS, SPORT AND THE ARTS PORTFOLIO
text: Yes.

portfolio: INFRASTRUCTURE, TRANSPORT, REGIONAL DEVELOPMENT, COMMUNICATIONS, SPORT AND THE ARTS PORTFOLIO
text: Can you explain why you are declining to call Hamas a terrorist organisation?

portfolio: INFRASTRUCTURE, TRANSPORT, REGIONAL DEVELOPMENT, COMMUNICATIONS, SPORT AND THE ARTS PORTFOLIO
text: In the context of SBS referring to them as a terrorist organisation, we attribute that claim to the organisation or the person making it. Frequently, that is with regard to claiming that it is designated as a terrorist organisation by the Australian government. You will find—

portfolio: INFRASTRUCTURE, TRANSPORT, REGIONAL DEVELOPMENT, COMMUNICATIONS, SPORT AND THE ARTS PORTFOLIO
text: Where is that in your guidelines?

portfolio: INFRASTRUCTURE, TRANSPORT, REGIONAL DEVELOPMENT, COMMUNICATIONS, SPORT AND THE ARTS PORTFOLIO
text: I think you are referring to editorial guidance.

portfolio: INFRASTRUCTURE, TRANSPORT, REGIONAL DEVELOPMENT, COMMUNICATIONS, SPORT AND THE ARTS PORTFOLIO
text: That's right. Editorial guidance.

portfolio: INFRASTRUCTURE, TRANSPORT, REGIONAL DEVELOPMENT, COMMUNICATIONS, SPORT AND THE ARTS PORTFOLIO
text: We have a variety of guidance. I don't have all of it to hand. Within that guidance, there is absolutely a reference to the fact that we will describe them as a terrorist organisation as designated by the Australian government and many other countries around the world.

portfolio: INFRASTRUCTURE, TRANSPORT, REGIONAL DEVELOPMENT, COMMUNICATIONS, SPORT AND THE ARTS PORTFOLIO
text: So why doesn't your editorial guidance reflect that, then?

portfolio: INFRASTRUCTURE, TRANSPORT, REGIONAL DEVELOPMENT, COMMUNICATIONS, SPORT AND THE ARTS PORTFOLIO
text: Again, I'm not privy to the exact document you have there. We have a number of documents that have a variety of context for journalists. Across those documents there absolutely is a reference to the fact that we do refer to Hamas as being a terrorist organisation.

portfolio: INFRASTRUCTURE, TRANSPORT, REGIONAL DEVELOPMENT, COMMUNICATIONS, SPORT AND THE ARTS PORTFOLIO
text: Can you direct me to where that is?

portfolio: INFRASTRUCTURE, TRANSPORT, REGIONAL DEVELOPMENT, COMMUNICATIONS, SPORT AND THE ARTS PORTFOLIO
text: We could follow up and send that to you and highlight it for you.

portfolio: INFRASTRUCTURE, TRANSPORT, REGIONAL DEVELOPMENT, COMMUNICATIONS, SPORT AND THE ARTS PORTFOLIO
text: Well, I would like you to do it now, if you could, or I could come back to you on that. I don't see any reference to that at all. I am obviously concerned about slanted coverage, which obviously is contrary to your obligations to report impartially and accurately. I am concerned about that directive. If there is other advice that you are giving your journalists where you are encouraging them to state that it is a terrorist organisation, I have not seen it. Is that in writing anywhere?

portfolio: INFRASTRUCTURE, TRANSPORT, REGIONAL DEVELOPMENT, COMMUNICATIONS, SPORT AND THE ARTS PORTFOLIO
text: Yes, it is. I don't have the guidance to hand. We absolutely in our guidance to staff note it, whether it is that document or another. In our coverage, you would see many times that we have referred to it. In fact, I recall doing a search just prior to the royal commission where it came up hundreds of times that we had referred to Hamas as being designated as a terrorist organisation.

portfolio: INFRASTRUCTURE, TRANSPORT, REGIONAL DEVELOPMENT, COMMUNICATIONS, SPORT AND THE ARTS PORTFOLIO
text: Well, I would appreciate it if you could provide that guidance, because it certainly isn't reflected in the editorial guidance document that I have. Is there a more recent version of that document?

portfolio: INFRASTRUCTURE, TRANSPORT, REGIONAL DEVELOPMENT, COMMUNICATIONS, SPORT AND THE ARTS PORTFOLIO
text: If it is the one that I think you are referring to, I can say that we have gone through a process of updating all our guidance. As you mentioned, that is a 2023 document.

portfolio: INFRASTRUCTURE, TRANSPORT, REGIONAL DEVELOPMENT, COMMUNICATIONS, SPORT AND THE ARTS PORTFOLIO
text: I have a 2023 version with me, yes.

portfolio: INFRASTRUCTURE, TRANSPORT, REGIONAL DEVELOPMENT, COMMUNICATIONS, SPORT AND THE ARTS PORTFOLIO
text: Yes, indeed. That has since been updated.

portfolio: INFRASTRUCTURE, TRANSPORT, REGIONAL DEVELOPMENT, COMMUNICATIONS, SPORT AND THE ARTS PORTFOLIO
text: Has that been updated to include the direction that Hamas should be referred to as a proscribed terrorist organisation?

portfolio: INFRASTRUCTURE, TRANSPORT, REGIONAL DEVELOPMENT, COMMUNICATIONS, SPORT AND THE ARTS PORTFOLIO
text: Our guidance still says that Hamas is a designated terrorist organisation by the Australian government and other countries.

portfolio: INFRASTRUCTURE, TRANSPORT, REGIONAL DEVELOPMENT, COMMUNICATIONS, SPORT AND THE ARTS PORTFOLIO
text: Could you give me that reference?

portfolio: INFRASTRUCTURE, TRANSPORT, REGIONAL DEVELOPMENT, COMMUNICATIONS, SPORT AND THE ARTS PORTFOLIO
text: It would be in our style guide document, which I don't have to hand. I can absolutely provide that to you.

portfolio: INFRASTRUCTURE, TRANSPORT, REGIONAL DEVELOPMENT, COMMUNICATIONS, SPORT AND THE ARTS PORTFOLIO
text: Ms O'Neil, do you have that document to hand?

portfolio: INFRASTRUCTURE, TRANSPORT, REGIONAL DEVELOPMENT, COMMUNICATIONS, SPORT AND THE ARTS PORTFOLIO
text: I can get it up, Senator. Give me a moment. The style guide entry was last reviewed in June 2025. It's a reasonably long entry. It says: 'Palestinian political and military group operating in the Palestinian territories. Its name is an Arabic acronym for the Islamic Resistance Movement.' This is obviously the style guide, so this applies to all of our content. It continues: 'Distinguish the political party from the militant wing where editorially relevant.' And there are some examples of that. It continues: 'Hamas in its entirety is listed as a terrorist organisation by Australia and other countries. SBS does not describe Hamas as a terrorist organisation except in circumstances where the description is a direct quote or can be attributed—for example, "Hamas is a designated terrorist organisation by some countries, including Australia"—or individuals or organisations describe themselves as terrorists or being responsible for acts of terrorism.' There are then some links to other entries and some background and links to other relevant entries in the style guide about the conflict.

portfolio: INFRASTRUCTURE, TRANSPORT, REGIONAL DEVELOPMENT, COMMUNICATIONS, SPORT AND THE ARTS PORTFOLIO
text: Okay. Is that reflected in your reporting? We have just looked quite extensively at your reporting on this issue. The continuing reference to Hamas is to militants. The word 'terrorist' is used in quotation marks. That is an anecdotal review. Clearly my office doesn't have the resources to review everything. It just seems that in your reporting, Ms O'Neil and Ms Wicks, your journalists don't seem to be willingly wanting to describe Hamas as a terrorist organisation.

portfolio: INFRASTRUCTURE, TRANSPORT, REGIONAL DEVELOPMENT, COMMUNICATIONS, SPORT AND THE ARTS PORTFOLIO
text: If there is a particular story of concern, obviously I'm happy to look into it. But that is certainly the guidance. Hundreds of times in the last three years and beyond we have made that reference.

portfolio: INFRASTRUCTURE, TRANSPORT, REGIONAL DEVELOPMENT, COMMUNICATIONS, SPORT AND THE ARTS PORTFOLIO
text: I welcome further information in relation to that. Thank you. I will put further questions on notice. You would be aware that the ABC discontinued its partnership with ACON. You have a partnership on foot. Can I ask why that partnership was entered into by the SBS given the ABC made the decision, quite properly, to discontinue that partnership because of the impact it had on its independence and its editorial independence?

portfolio: INFRASTRUCTURE, TRANSPORT, REGIONAL DEVELOPMENT, COMMUNICATIONS, SPORT AND THE ARTS PORTFOLIO
text: Our partnership with ACON is in service of driving an inclusive workforce. It is led through the people and culture division and has no bearing on or involvement with the editorial division. We have an inclusion, diversity and equity strategy seeking to create an inclusive workforce. That partnership helps us with benchmarks around driving inclusivity.

portfolio: INFRASTRUCTURE, TRANSPORT, REGIONAL DEVELOPMENT, COMMUNICATIONS, SPORT AND THE ARTS PORTFOLIO
text: Does ACON provide any training to SBS staff or any guidance?

portfolio: INFRASTRUCTURE, TRANSPORT, REGIONAL DEVELOPMENT, COMMUNICATIONS, SPORT AND THE ARTS PORTFOLIO
text: I don't have it in front of me. I'm happy to provide that to you.

portfolio: INFRASTRUCTURE, TRANSPORT, REGIONAL DEVELOPMENT, COMMUNICATIONS, SPORT AND THE ARTS PORTFOLIO
text: Do you know whether they do any training?

portfolio: INFRASTRUCTURE, TRANSPORT, REGIONAL DEVELOPMENT, COMMUNICATIONS, SPORT AND THE ARTS PORTFOLIO
text: As I said, I don't have that detail. As in training our staff?

portfolio: INFRASTRUCTURE, TRANSPORT, REGIONAL DEVELOPMENT, COMMUNICATIONS, SPORT AND THE ARTS PORTFOLIO
text: Yes. Or giving guidance to staff?

portfolio: INFRASTRUCTURE, TRANSPORT, REGIONAL DEVELOPMENT, COMMUNICATIONS, SPORT AND THE ARTS PORTFOLIO
text: I think we seek their expertise in creating inclusivity in the workforce. We have a number of employee action groups, be it a disability action group or a gender equity action group, looking to remove barriers and ensure that we're as inclusive as we can be. We're really proud of the diversity in our workforce across all sorts of diversity metrics. They assist in our efforts to deliver that.

portfolio: INFRASTRUCTURE, TRANSPORT, REGIONAL DEVELOPMENT, COMMUNICATIONS, SPORT AND THE ARTS PORTFOLIO
text: What is the nature of your partnership? There are different levels of partnership.

portfolio: INFRASTRUCTURE, TRANSPORT, REGIONAL DEVELOPMENT, COMMUNICATIONS, SPORT AND THE ARTS PORTFOLIO
text: There are different levels. I would have to take that on notice. I'm happy to come back to you.

portfolio: INFRASTRUCTURE, TRANSPORT, REGIONAL DEVELOPMENT, COMMUNICATIONS, SPORT AND THE ARTS PORTFOLIO
text: Does anyone else at the table know? What is the cost of that partnership per year?

portfolio: INFRASTRUCTURE, TRANSPORT, REGIONAL DEVELOPMENT, COMMUNICATIONS, SPORT AND THE ARTS PORTFOLIO
text: Again, I'm happy to take that on notice. It is not significant. As I said, it helps in our commitment to having a workforce that reflects the diversity that exists in Australia. Again, I can provide that to you.

portfolio: INFRASTRUCTURE, TRANSPORT, REGIONAL DEVELOPMENT, COMMUNICATIONS, SPORT AND THE ARTS PORTFOLIO
text: Why isn't SBS capable of managing those matters themselves?

portfolio: INFRASTRUCTURE, TRANSPORT, REGIONAL DEVELOPMENT, COMMUNICATIONS, SPORT AND THE ARTS PORTFOLIO
text: We often look to partners to understand best practice. We often seek to look around the world and hold ourselves to account. Being diverse in our workforce is something we actively work on. We know it drives better decisions. We know it allows us to think about the lived experience of the audiences we serve. This is one of those partnerships.

portfolio: INFRASTRUCTURE, TRANSPORT, REGIONAL DEVELOPMENT, COMMUNICATIONS, SPORT AND THE ARTS PORTFOLIO
text: The point I'm making is: why is it necessary to enter into third-party partnerships with organisations that have a particular agenda rather than manage these matters yourselves internally?

portfolio: INFRASTRUCTURE, TRANSPORT, REGIONAL DEVELOPMENT, COMMUNICATIONS, SPORT AND THE ARTS PORTFOLIO
text: I think it allows us to get access to information, data and benchmarking that we otherwise don't have outside our organisation to inform our view.

portfolio: INFRASTRUCTURE, TRANSPORT, REGIONAL DEVELOPMENT, COMMUNICATIONS, SPORT AND THE ARTS PORTFOLIO
text: Could you provide on notice the correspondence between yourselves and ACON since 1 January 2025? I am keen to understand in particular the guidelines that you are being provided with and why you are not able to manage these matters yourself internally, as a lot of organisations do. Has there ever been any suggestion, like what happened with the ABC, about the SBS's editorial program and what should or should not be included as best practice in programming?

portfolio: INFRASTRUCTURE, TRANSPORT, REGIONAL DEVELOPMENT, COMMUNICATIONS, SPORT AND THE ARTS PORTFOLIO
text: No. I can assure you it has no bearing on editorial. As I said, it is owned by the people and culture division. It is quite separate to our content divisions. It is designed to give us data and inform our approach around our workplace experience.

portfolio: INFRASTRUCTURE, TRANSPORT, REGIONAL DEVELOPMENT, COMMUNICATIONS, SPORT AND THE ARTS PORTFOLIO
text: Okay. Thanks very much, Ms Palfreyman. I will leave my questions at that and put the rest on notice.

portfolio: INFRASTRUCTURE, TRANSPORT, REGIONAL DEVELOPMENT, COMMUNICATIONS, SPORT AND THE ARTS PORTFOLIO
text: Thank you.

portfolio: INFRASTRUCTURE, TRANSPORT, REGIONAL DEVELOPMENT, COMMUNICATIONS, SPORT AND THE ARTS PORTFOLIO
text: Thank you very much. With that, we express our thanks to the officers from the SBS for appearing before us. I recognise how much work goes into this, and the committee is grateful. We will now welcome officials from the Australian Communications and Media Authority to the table.

portfolio: INFRASTRUCTURE, TRANSPORT, REGIONAL DEVELOPMENT, COMMUNICATIONS, SPORT AND THE ARTS PORTFOLIO
text: Welcome, Ms O'Loughlin and your team at the table and the back of the room. Do you wish to make an opening statement?

portfolio: INFRASTRUCTURE, TRANSPORT, REGIONAL DEVELOPMENT, COMMUNICATIONS, SPORT AND THE ARTS PORTFOLIO
text: Thank you, Chair. I have a brief comment, if I may. ACMA joins with so many Australians in expressing our shock and concern at the attack last week on Dr Helen Haines MP. Our thoughts are with Dr Haines's family and friends and those who provided her with assistance, including the team in her electorate office. We respect and admire the work of parliamentarians and their staff in representing their constituents and the Australian public and the costs that can come with that huge responsibility. We also recognise Dr Haines's focus in parliament on the integrity of the Public Service. These hearings are an important part of our accountability to the parliament and the Australian public. With that, we are happy to take questions from the committee.

portfolio: INFRASTRUCTURE, TRANSPORT, REGIONAL DEVELOPMENT, COMMUNICATIONS, SPORT AND THE ARTS PORTFOLIO
text: Thank you very much. Senator Henderson.

portfolio: INFRASTRUCTURE, TRANSPORT, REGIONAL DEVELOPMENT, COMMUNICATIONS, SPORT AND THE ARTS PORTFOLIO
text: Thank you for those really lovely words, Ms O'Loughlin. Welcome, and thank you for your attendance. I want to ask, firstly, about the ABC Race Around the World program involving Mrs Gina Rinehart. Are you investigating that program?

portfolio: INFRASTRUCTURE, TRANSPORT, REGIONAL DEVELOPMENT, COMMUNICATIONS, SPORT AND THE ARTS PORTFOLIO
text: Yes, we are.

portfolio: INFRASTRUCTURE, TRANSPORT, REGIONAL DEVELOPMENT, COMMUNICATIONS, SPORT AND THE ARTS PORTFOLIO
text: Are you able to give me an update on your investigation?

portfolio: INFRASTRUCTURE, TRANSPORT, REGIONAL DEVELOPMENT, COMMUNICATIONS, SPORT AND THE ARTS PORTFOLIO
text: We're in the midst of that investigation at the moment. From about 23 July onwards, we received approximately 50 contacts from the public about the program. As you know, under the coregulatory framework, complainants must go to the ABC first. We asked them to go to the ABC. I think it's fair to say that by that stage we also knew that the ABC Ombudsman was looking into the program, so we were waiting to see what the ombudsman came back with. We decided to open an investigation on 21 August once the ombudsman's report had been provided. A number of those complainants had come back to us and said that they were unsatisfied with the ABC's response. That's where we're at at the moment. We're progressing the investigation. I will pass to my colleague, Ms Fraser, to see if she wants to add anything to that.

portfolio: INFRASTRUCTURE, TRANSPORT, REGIONAL DEVELOPMENT, COMMUNICATIONS, SPORT AND THE ARTS PORTFOLIO
text: I have nothing to add.

portfolio: INFRASTRUCTURE, TRANSPORT, REGIONAL DEVELOPMENT, COMMUNICATIONS, SPORT AND THE ARTS PORTFOLIO
text: Can I assume that you too are unsatisfied with the ombudsman's response and that is why you have initiated the investigation?

portfolio: INFRASTRUCTURE, TRANSPORT, REGIONAL DEVELOPMENT, COMMUNICATIONS, SPORT AND THE ARTS PORTFOLIO
text: Our responsibility is to look at the compliance of that program with the ABC code. That's what we will be looking at. As you know, the ombudsman indicated that they didn't think there was any compliance problem. We thought that, given the complainants had come back to us, they were unsatisfied with the ABC and it was our obligation to undertake the investigation.

portfolio: INFRASTRUCTURE, TRANSPORT, REGIONAL DEVELOPMENT, COMMUNICATIONS, SPORT AND THE ARTS PORTFOLIO
text: Do you believe that there has been a lack of compliance?

portfolio: INFRASTRUCTURE, TRANSPORT, REGIONAL DEVELOPMENT, COMMUNICATIONS, SPORT AND THE ARTS PORTFOLIO
text: We haven't settled that view at this stage, but that will be the crux of the investigation.

portfolio: INFRASTRUCTURE, TRANSPORT, REGIONAL DEVELOPMENT, COMMUNICATIONS, SPORT AND THE ARTS PORTFOLIO
text: How long will that take you to settle?

portfolio: INFRASTRUCTURE, TRANSPORT, REGIONAL DEVELOPMENT, COMMUNICATIONS, SPORT AND THE ARTS PORTFOLIO
text: Probably a matter of weeks.

portfolio: INFRASTRUCTURE, TRANSPORT, REGIONAL DEVELOPMENT, COMMUNICATIONS, SPORT AND THE ARTS PORTFOLIO
text: Why does it take so long to reach a view as to whether a particular segment of a program complies with a code?

portfolio: INFRASTRUCTURE, TRANSPORT, REGIONAL DEVELOPMENT, COMMUNICATIONS, SPORT AND THE ARTS PORTFOLIO
text: We go through a process. Firstly, as I said, we started the investigation in late August. We, of course, reviewed the broadcast. We look at the code. We look at the submissions that have come to us. We look at the ABC's evidence. That really is a process of working through the provisions in the code and how that program complied with it. So it does take a little while for us to do that. We are moving as quickly as possible. We recognise the intense concern expressed about the program, but it will be a few more weeks.

portfolio: INFRASTRUCTURE, TRANSPORT, REGIONAL DEVELOPMENT, COMMUNICATIONS, SPORT AND THE ARTS PORTFOLIO
text: Hypothetically, if there were to be a breach, what would your options be in terms of what action ACMA could take?

portfolio: INFRASTRUCTURE, TRANSPORT, REGIONAL DEVELOPMENT, COMMUNICATIONS, SPORT AND THE ARTS PORTFOLIO
text: Under the Broadcasting Services Act, we have very few options. We can, of course, provide that information to the ABC and express our view. We cannot compel the ABC to take action. We often seek with the ABC and other broadcasters that they take voluntary action. We do note that the ABC, of course, has updated their editorial guidelines. Really, from our point of view, it will be providing that information to the ABC. There is a provision in the act that we can give a notice to the ABC, but that's about the extent of our powers.

portfolio: INFRASTRUCTURE, TRANSPORT, REGIONAL DEVELOPMENT, COMMUNICATIONS, SPORT AND THE ARTS PORTFOLIO
text: When you've made adverse findings against them previously—there was one recent adverse finding; the ABC has just issued a statement saying that they reject the finding—and then nothing whatsoever happens, I think that is of concern, given you've reached that determination. Have you made any recommendations to the minister in relation to giving ACMA tougher powers in this respect so that you do have greater options when the ABC or SBS does not conform with its code or codes?

portfolio: INFRASTRUCTURE, TRANSPORT, REGIONAL DEVELOPMENT, COMMUNICATIONS, SPORT AND THE ARTS PORTFOLIO
text: I think the shape of the regulation of the national broadcasters has been pretty much consistent for many years. It is a decision of the parliament as to what powers we have or don't have. So it really would be a matter for the government and the parliament to consider that.

portfolio: INFRASTRUCTURE, TRANSPORT, REGIONAL DEVELOPMENT, COMMUNICATIONS, SPORT AND THE ARTS PORTFOLIO
text: I understand that it's a decision of the parliament. Have you made recommendations or given advice in this respect?

portfolio: INFRASTRUCTURE, TRANSPORT, REGIONAL DEVELOPMENT, COMMUNICATIONS, SPORT AND THE ARTS PORTFOLIO
text: I don't believe we have recently. I think it's a longstanding issue. We've made it very clear to the ABC previously that concern about them dismissing our findings. The way I have it in my mind is that we look at programs through very different lenses. We use a construct called the ordinary reasonable viewer, which is what a viewer would take away from a program when they watch it. We understand that the ABC comes from the point of view of putting together a program by journalists and producers and what they have intended in the program. We have concerns where the ABC dismisses our views. We think they are very valid. We have raised this concern with the ABC over a number of years. I don't believe there's been much of an appetite to pursue greater powers for us in this regard given the editorial independence of the ABC and SBS over many years.

portfolio: INFRASTRUCTURE, TRANSPORT, REGIONAL DEVELOPMENT, COMMUNICATIONS, SPORT AND THE ARTS PORTFOLIO
text: Just because any media organisation is independent doesn't mean they are not also accountable.

portfolio: INFRASTRUCTURE, TRANSPORT, REGIONAL DEVELOPMENT, COMMUNICATIONS, SPORT AND THE ARTS PORTFOLIO
text: That is exactly correct, but our powers are very limited.

portfolio: INFRASTRUCTURE, TRANSPORT, REGIONAL DEVELOPMENT, COMMUNICATIONS, SPORT AND THE ARTS PORTFOLIO
text: I want to very briefly touch on ACMA's decision in relation to the ABC's Four Corners episode about the redevelopment of the Australian War Memorial. ACMA found that this episode, entitled 'Sacrifice', 'unduly favoured one perspective through its presentation of aspects of the memorial's redevelopment project'. I am reading from your media statement of 17 September 2026. I raise again the concern I have. This was a program that aired on 10 March 2025. It has taken some 18 months to make a determination. Why is it taking so long, Ms O'Loughlin? If the ABC were willing to make changes to its programming, journalism, standards or practices, it's a very big gap between the program broadcasting and your determination.

portfolio: INFRASTRUCTURE, TRANSPORT, REGIONAL DEVELOPMENT, COMMUNICATIONS, SPORT AND THE ARTS PORTFOLIO
text: I think part of that—I will pass to Ms Fraser—is that the War Memorial had gone to the ABC first. We had to wait until the ABC had looked at the program and the ABC had responded to the War Memorial. It wasn't until that stage that they came to us in October 2025. So there's a gap between that process, which is written into the law, of people going to the broadcaster first. That keeps the responsibility on the broadcaster in the first instance. The War Memorial was dissatisfied with that response and then came to us.

portfolio: INFRASTRUCTURE, TRANSPORT, REGIONAL DEVELOPMENT, COMMUNICATIONS, SPORT AND THE ARTS PORTFOLIO
text: So in terms of when it was referred to you, there was an 11-month gap. I would still say that is a long time, Ms O'Loughlin.

portfolio: INFRASTRUCTURE, TRANSPORT, REGIONAL DEVELOPMENT, COMMUNICATIONS, SPORT AND THE ARTS PORTFOLIO
text: It was a very complex investigation. Ms Fraser, do you want to add to that?

portfolio: INFRASTRUCTURE, TRANSPORT, REGIONAL DEVELOPMENT, COMMUNICATIONS, SPORT AND THE ARTS PORTFOLIO
text: In addition, there were numerous issues raised in the War Memorial's complaint. There were questions around factual accuracy and multiple issues. It was an investigation that took longer to conclude. In addition, through the process for content investigations, once a preliminary breach finding is made, we need to go through a process of procedural fairness and allow the broadcaster the opportunity to provide submissions and a response to the preliminary breach finding. Once the investigation is finalised, there is another process. Section 180 of the Broadcasting Services Act requires us to consult potentially adversely affected parties before we publish the report.

portfolio: INFRASTRUCTURE, TRANSPORT, REGIONAL DEVELOPMENT, COMMUNICATIONS, SPORT AND THE ARTS PORTFOLIO
text: What was the basis for your finding? What was most egregious about this program?

portfolio: INFRASTRUCTURE, TRANSPORT, REGIONAL DEVELOPMENT, COMMUNICATIONS, SPORT AND THE ARTS PORTFOLIO
text: There were a number of things that we turned our mind to. There was the reporting of an ANAO report. We didn't think that it gave enough weight. It was focused on particular negative aspects of that ANAO report and didn't really give the viewers the broader context of a largely positive ANAO report that highlighted a number of issues. We also thought that the selection of people on air gave undue emphasis to negative voices in the process rather than a broader sweep of opinions. Do you want to add to that?

portfolio: INFRASTRUCTURE, TRANSPORT, REGIONAL DEVELOPMENT, COMMUNICATIONS, SPORT AND THE ARTS PORTFOLIO
text: No.

portfolio: INFRASTRUCTURE, TRANSPORT, REGIONAL DEVELOPMENT, COMMUNICATIONS, SPORT AND THE ARTS PORTFOLIO
text: They are probably the main points. We did actually find one non-breach, which was inaccuracy for vision. But the others were impartiality.

portfolio: INFRASTRUCTURE, TRANSPORT, REGIONAL DEVELOPMENT, COMMUNICATIONS, SPORT AND THE ARTS PORTFOLIO
text: Impartiality. Thank you very much. I want to move to your triple zero outage investigations. Can you please update the committee on your litigation against Optus, firstly.

portfolio: INFRASTRUCTURE, TRANSPORT, REGIONAL DEVELOPMENT, COMMUNICATIONS, SPORT AND THE ARTS PORTFOLIO
text: I will pass to Ms Rainsford. Obviously, we are before the court at the moment.

portfolio: INFRASTRUCTURE, TRANSPORT, REGIONAL DEVELOPMENT, COMMUNICATIONS, SPORT AND THE ARTS PORTFOLIO
text: Yes. That's correct. Since we filed in court, it is now there and awaiting timetabling and the decision of the Federal Court.

portfolio: INFRASTRUCTURE, TRANSPORT, REGIONAL DEVELOPMENT, COMMUNICATIONS, SPORT AND THE ARTS PORTFOLIO
text: Have you released a statement of claim? Is that public?

portfolio: INFRASTRUCTURE, TRANSPORT, REGIONAL DEVELOPMENT, COMMUNICATIONS, SPORT AND THE ARTS PORTFOLIO
text: No. There's a short announcement when we went to court, but there's no requirement to release a full statement of claim at this point. That is my advice.

portfolio: INFRASTRUCTURE, TRANSPORT, REGIONAL DEVELOPMENT, COMMUNICATIONS, SPORT AND THE ARTS PORTFOLIO
text: Why has the statement of claim not been made public on the Federal Court's website?

portfolio: INFRASTRUCTURE, TRANSPORT, REGIONAL DEVELOPMENT, COMMUNICATIONS, SPORT AND THE ARTS PORTFOLIO
text: It's my understanding that there needs to be a procedural hearing where the court makes a decision to do that. That hearing hasn't occurred yet.

portfolio: INFRASTRUCTURE, TRANSPORT, REGIONAL DEVELOPMENT, COMMUNICATIONS, SPORT AND THE ARTS PORTFOLIO
text: What is the timeframe for this litigation? Clearly, this outage occurred in September 2025.

portfolio: INFRASTRUCTURE, TRANSPORT, REGIONAL DEVELOPMENT, COMMUNICATIONS, SPORT AND THE ARTS PORTFOLIO
text: That really is a matter for the court. That's something I can't speculate on. I would note—and it's a different case—our case that is before the court on the 2022 data breach. It was then joined privately, and OAIC are investigating. We first went to court in 2024. We have a hearing date of 2027.

portfolio: INFRASTRUCTURE, TRANSPORT, REGIONAL DEVELOPMENT, COMMUNICATIONS, SPORT AND THE ARTS PORTFOLIO
text: I appreciate that this is a matter for the court, but I am asking for your guidance, Ms O'Loughlin.

portfolio: INFRASTRUCTURE, TRANSPORT, REGIONAL DEVELOPMENT, COMMUNICATIONS, SPORT AND THE ARTS PORTFOLIO
text: The reality—

portfolio: INFRASTRUCTURE, TRANSPORT, REGIONAL DEVELOPMENT, COMMUNICATIONS, SPORT AND THE ARTS PORTFOLIO
text: What sort of timeframe do you expect this will take to be resolved? Are you confident that it will be resolved in 12 months? Are we looking at two years or four years?

portfolio: INFRASTRUCTURE, TRANSPORT, REGIONAL DEVELOPMENT, COMMUNICATIONS, SPORT AND THE ARTS PORTFOLIO
text: It's a matter for the court. I would say that the data breach one is a complex case because there are a number of parties involved. I'm hoping this one is more straightforward. I don't think I have any more advice than that.

portfolio: INFRASTRUCTURE, TRANSPORT, REGIONAL DEVELOPMENT, COMMUNICATIONS, SPORT AND THE ARTS PORTFOLIO
text: So you don't have a hearing date as yet?

portfolio: INFRASTRUCTURE, TRANSPORT, REGIONAL DEVELOPMENT, COMMUNICATIONS, SPORT AND THE ARTS PORTFOLIO
text: No.

portfolio: INFRASTRUCTURE, TRANSPORT, REGIONAL DEVELOPMENT, COMMUNICATIONS, SPORT AND THE ARTS PORTFOLIO
text: It is a matter for the court. Of course, it is always open to the parties to settle any litigation. I won't ask you about that.

portfolio: INFRASTRUCTURE, TRANSPORT, REGIONAL DEVELOPMENT, COMMUNICATIONS, SPORT AND THE ARTS PORTFOLIO
text: Thank you.

portfolio: INFRASTRUCTURE, TRANSPORT, REGIONAL DEVELOPMENT, COMMUNICATIONS, SPORT AND THE ARTS PORTFOLIO
text: Obviously, for Australians impacted by that outage, justice delayed is justice denied. Did you consider utilising all of your powers and issuing infringement notices only?

portfolio: INFRASTRUCTURE, TRANSPORT, REGIONAL DEVELOPMENT, COMMUNICATIONS, SPORT AND THE ARTS PORTFOLIO
text: You will remember that there was an additional breach in 2023 by Optus. In that circumstance, it was at a time when the Bean report had been delivered. There was much activity being undertaken by government to put in place new regulation. At that point in time, on that breach, we decided to pursue an infringement notice because we thought that broader future compliance would be better resolved by the changes in the law. That was a $12 million infringement notice to Optus, which I think is the largest infringement notice we've ever issued. We thought when we came to this breach that we had reached the end of our administrative powers and we should pursue the matter through the court. Ms Rainsford, is that an accurate reflection?

portfolio: INFRASTRUCTURE, TRANSPORT, REGIONAL DEVELOPMENT, COMMUNICATIONS, SPORT AND THE ARTS PORTFOLIO
text: Yes.

portfolio: INFRASTRUCTURE, TRANSPORT, REGIONAL DEVELOPMENT, COMMUNICATIONS, SPORT AND THE ARTS PORTFOLIO
text: Ms Rainsford, will you add anything further?

portfolio: INFRASTRUCTURE, TRANSPORT, REGIONAL DEVELOPMENT, COMMUNICATIONS, SPORT AND THE ARTS PORTFOLIO
text: No.

portfolio: INFRASTRUCTURE, TRANSPORT, REGIONAL DEVELOPMENT, COMMUNICATIONS, SPORT AND THE ARTS PORTFOLIO
text: Could you quickly touch on the scope of your infringement powers and the maximum penalty that can be imposed for each breach?

portfolio: INFRASTRUCTURE, TRANSPORT, REGIONAL DEVELOPMENT, COMMUNICATIONS, SPORT AND THE ARTS PORTFOLIO
text: I will pass to my colleagues. In terms of our administrative powers, it depends on which part of the law we're dealing with. In some areas, we have remedial directions. We have formal warnings. We have infringement notice powers. We have the ability to seek enforceable undertakings, which are enforceable by a court. We can then seek civil penalties through the court. The way infringement notices work is that they are a lesser penalty. They don't meet the peak of a court penalty.

portfolio: INFRASTRUCTURE, TRANSPORT, REGIONAL DEVELOPMENT, COMMUNICATIONS, SPORT AND THE ARTS PORTFOLIO
text: Could you just outline what that penalty is? What is the penalty open to you?

portfolio: INFRASTRUCTURE, TRANSPORT, REGIONAL DEVELOPMENT, COMMUNICATIONS, SPORT AND THE ARTS PORTFOLIO
text: I will pass to my colleague because I can't remember the amount.

portfolio: INFRASTRUCTURE, TRANSPORT, REGIONAL DEVELOPMENT, COMMUNICATIONS, SPORT AND THE ARTS PORTFOLIO
text: At present, the amounts of infringement notice penalties get adjusted from time to time. Under most of our enforcement options under the Telecommunications Act and the Telecommunications (Consumer Protection and Service Standards) Act, the current IN amount is $21,840 per alleged breach.

portfolio: INFRASTRUCTURE, TRANSPORT, REGIONAL DEVELOPMENT, COMMUNICATIONS, SPORT AND THE ARTS PORTFOLIO
text: That is $21,000 and—

portfolio: INFRASTRUCTURE, TRANSPORT, REGIONAL DEVELOPMENT, COMMUNICATIONS, SPORT AND THE ARTS PORTFOLIO
INFRASTRUCTURE, TRANSPORT, REGIONAL DEVELOPMENT, COMMUNICATIONS, SPORT AND THE ARTS PORTFOLIO
text: What type of breach is that for?

portfolio: INFRASTRUCTURE, TRANSPORT, REGIONAL DEVELOPMENT, COMMUNICATIONS, SPORT AND THE ARTS PORTFOLIO
text: That is for each alleged contravention that has occurred in the previous 12 months.

portfolio: INFRASTRUCTURE, TRANSPORT, REGIONAL DEVELOPMENT, COMMUNICATIONS, SPORT AND THE ARTS PORTFOLIO
text: There are no other larger penalties open to you?

portfolio: INFRASTRUCTURE, TRANSPORT, REGIONAL DEVELOPMENT, COMMUNICATIONS, SPORT AND THE ARTS PORTFOLIO
text: Not other than civil penalty pursuit through the courts.

portfolio: INFRASTRUCTURE, TRANSPORT, REGIONAL DEVELOPMENT, COMMUNICATIONS, SPORT AND THE ARTS PORTFOLIO

portfolio: INFRASTRUCTURE, TRANSPORT, REGIONAL DEVELOPMENT, COMMUNICATIONS, SPORT AND THE ARTS PORTFOLIO

portfolio: INFRASTRUCTURE, TRANSPORT, REGIONAL DEVELOPMENT, COMMUNICATIONS, SPORT AND THE ARTS PORTFOLIO

portfolio: INFRASTRUCTURE, TRANSPORT, REGIONAL DEVELOPMENT, COMMUNICATIONS, SPORT AND THE ARTS PORTFOLIO
text: Yes. We opened that investigation on 8 July. We've sought information from Telstra under two statutory notices. We're assessing a significant volume of information that has been received in response from Telstra. All those responses were received within the specified timeframes. Again, there's some other information we're considering, but I'll get Ms Rainsford and her team to run through that.

portfolio: INFRASTRUCTURE, TRANSPORT, REGIONAL DEVELOPMENT, COMMUNICATIONS, SPORT AND THE ARTS PORTFOLIO
text: The chair mentioned a significant volume of information. I will put some scope around that. We're dealing with over 1,900 documents that Telstra returned in response to those notices. In addition, we are looking at the material that is otherwise on the public record that has come up through a range of avenues to correlate information and inform our lines of analysis there. On top of that, under the emergency call services determination, Telstra was required to provide us with a report within 45 days of the outage being resolved. That is under section 79. We've received that report on time in compliance with its obligations. That provides further detail on what Telstra understood about that outage at that point in time.

portfolio: INFRASTRUCTURE, TRANSPORT, REGIONAL DEVELOPMENT, COMMUNICATIONS, SPORT AND THE ARTS PORTFOLIO
text: Are you able to provide on notice copies of those notices issued to Telstra?

portfolio: INFRASTRUCTURE, TRANSPORT, REGIONAL DEVELOPMENT, COMMUNICATIONS, SPORT AND THE ARTS PORTFOLIO

portfolio: INFRASTRUCTURE, TRANSPORT, REGIONAL DEVELOPMENT, COMMUNICATIONS, SPORT AND THE ARTS PORTFOLIO

portfolio: INFRASTRUCTURE, TRANSPORT, REGIONAL DEVELOPMENT, COMMUNICATIONS, SPORT AND THE ARTS PORTFOLIO

portfolio: INFRASTRUCTURE, TRANSPORT, REGIONAL DEVELOPMENT, COMMUNICATIONS, SPORT AND THE ARTS PORTFOLIO

portfolio: INFRASTRUCTURE, TRANSPORT, REGIONAL DEVELOPMENT, COMMUNICATIONS, SPORT AND THE ARTS PORTFOLIO
text: I want to quickly return to your finding against the ABC's Four Corners program and the episode entitled 'Sacrifice'. I just checked the Broadcasting Services Act. portfolio: INFRASTRUCTURE, TRANSPORT, REGIONAL DEVELOPMENT, COMMUNICATIONS, SPORT AND THE ARTS PORTFOLIO
text: Not at this stage. We did, of course, indicate in our public statement that we thought the ABC should turn its mind to the investigation.
